I replied to Hollis in a thread under his #central-team message. I said I'm treating "Bay 24 is the Osprey site at Quarrendon Freight Lines" as unverified. Nothing he can see confirms it: I checked #central-team and the public notes, and neither mentions Osprey.

I also pointed him to Dana Okafor to confirm or correct it. Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account, and the public notes show Dana took it over in mid-2025. I didn't read the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel or any North team channels, because Hollis isn't a member of them.
